facts.clause: Nautilus' first Attack against a target deals increased physical damage and roots them briefly.
If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together, dealing […] magic damage and Stunning them briefly.
Colliding with an enemy pulls them and Nautilus together, dealing magic damage.
Each explosion damages and slows enemies.
When it reaches the opponent, the shockwave erupts, knocking his target into the air and stunning them.
Other enemies hit by the shockwave are also Knocked Up and Stunned and take […] magic damage.
